project.name: Pitcorthie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 3 of 14. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. The standing stone is retained on the heritage heat layer but is not promoted as a public attraction without dependable access. Kilrenny and Crail facilities are not transferred.
